_note: delivery: lovable (final site to a new Lovable project via GitHub) or html (final designs as HTML files via npm run export). release_target: the branch releases merge into.

lovable._note: showcase=false: never push the showcase/library to Lovable (results shown with npm run sheet). sites=true: a built client site may be pushed to its own new Lovable project via GitHub sync (0 Lovable credits).

showcase_note: showcase_url: the published URL of the Lovable showcase project (e.g. https://design-showcase.lovable.app). Used to print live links.
